1.w: By David. The Lord is my light and my salvation. I fear no one. The Lord protects my life. I am afraid of no one.

2.w: When evil men attack me to devour my flesh, when my adversaries and enemies attack me, they stumble and fall.

3.w: Even when an army is deployed against me, I do not fear. Even when war is imminent, I remain confident.

4.w: I have asked the Lord for one thing— this is what I desire! I want to live in the Lord ’s house all the days of my life, so I can gaze at the splendor of the Lord and contemplate in his temple.

5.w: He will surely give me shelter in the day of danger; he will hide me in his home. He will place me on an inaccessible rocky summit.

6.w: Now I will triumph over my enemies who surround me. I will offer sacrifices in his dwelling place and shout for joy. I will sing praises to the Lord .

7.w: Hear me, O Lord , when I cry out. Have mercy on me and answer me.

8.w: My heart tells me to pray to you, and I do pray to you, O Lord .

9.w: Do not reject me. Do not push your servant away in anger. You are my deliverer. Do not forsake or abandon me, O God who vindicates me.

10.w: Even if my father and mother abandoned me, the Lord would take me in.

11.w: Teach me how you want me to live, Lord ; lead me along a level path because of those who wait to ambush me.

12.w: Do not turn me over to my enemies, for false witnesses who want to destroy me testify against me.

13.w: Where would I be if I did not believe I would experience the Lord ’s favor in the land of the living?

14.w: Rely on the Lord ! Be strong and confident! Rely on the Lord !
